notes: Every number is a measurement on the Arc A770 with nothing else on the card (llama.cpp Vulkan, -ub 512); the ledger config/models.md holds the rows. This registry is read when A770B_CARD_MODE=inference; config/profiles.json is read in display mode. useful_ctx is where prefill falls under 150 tok/s or decode under the profile's floor. builder.env and the environment override any A770B_<NAME>_* value; the card reports what is served.

long.architecture: dense, hybrid attention (Gated DeltaNet + gated attention, 4 KV heads)
long.use_for: The default: every ordinary change, tests from a specification, and a read up to about 64k; served at the model's full native window. Reads exactly at 100k but takes eleven minutes to get there.

serious.architecture: dense, hybrid attention (4 KV heads, 64 blocks)
serious.task_t1: pass (at 98,304 on the shared card; the run at this window is in the ledger)
serious.capability_source: ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO model card (quantiser's evaluation; BF16 85.71 / 89.90 / 100; the quantiser's task-lossless file)
serious.use_for: A deliverable larger than its brief, tests written from an unfamiliar module, a change touching several files. The quantiser's task-lossless file at the largest window the free card holds; ten to twenty-five minutes; decode under five tokens a second by 64k, so point it at files that fit 32k.
